scope: Five independent, visually reviewed landscape photographs from Jervis Bay Territory. Per-file Commons reuse declarations and primary Parks Australia place references checked. Photo rights do not establish visitor access, cultural permission, an AVES partnership or a commercial tour concession. No sacred site, ceremony, rock art or identifiable visitor selected.

visualReview: Originals inspected together before conversion. Five different scenes: Murrays rocky shoreline, Green Patch creek and forest, Cave Beach cliff and cave, Bowen Island across open water and Cape St George lighthouse ruins. No duplicate crop or substitute NSW location. All photographs are historical landscape references.
